column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.

column2: Below 3 km/h, the motor can pull from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.
column3: Under 3 km/h kan motoren trække fra stilstand, så snart du bruger gashåndtaget.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.
column3: Energigenvinding bliver slået fra, så motoren ikke bremser, og dine bremser skal klare mere af opbremsningen.
column4: Energy recovery will be turned off, so the motor does not brake, and your brakes must handle more of the braking.

column2: Caps your speed while riding, below your Top speed setting. Set back restores your previous setting.
column3: Din hastighed bliver begrænset under kørsel, så den holder sig under din indstilling for topfart. Med ”Sæt tilbage” får du din tidligere indstilling igen.
column4: Your speed will be limited while riding, so that it stays below your setting for top speed. With "Set back" you get your previous setting again.
